name: Izsófalva (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, white at the hoist and light blue at the fly, charged near the top of the white with the municipal arms of Izsófalva (a green and blue shield with crossed hammers, a hand and ears of grain) above the name IZSÓFALVA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
